events.action: {"message": "Fixed the defect in `tests/kernel/sched/schedule_api/src/test_sched_timeslice_and_lock.c` where `test_sleep_cooperative` called `k_yield()` instead of `k_sleep(K_MSEC(100))`. With `k_yield()`, the cooperative main thread at priority -1 stayed runnable in the ready queue, preventing the lower-priority thread at priority 0 (`tdata[2]`) from running. Calling `k_sleep(K_MSEC(100))` places the main thread in the timeout queue as documented, allowing all three spawned threads to execute and the test suite to pass.", "kind": "FinishAction"}
